findings.description: The added `.strip()` removes the trailing space from the prompt text, so the prompt no longer ends with the separator `": "` that `prompt()` adds before the cursor.
findings.rationale: Trigger: `prompt()` runs with a non-tty stream and color not forced, so the new branch executes. `prompt()` builds the text as `f"{text}: "`, so the trailing space is stripped and `input()` displays `Name:` with the cursor directly after the colon. Impact: the user-visible prompt formatting changes for every stripped prompt, and typed input runs into the colon. Only `strip_ansi` was needed to fulfil the commit's intent.
